coverage.description: next_free returns fixed registry order L,O,C,R,E,P,B with maximum stored number plus one; no search for internal holes. fresh rejects IDs already in either registry. place_n returns a location ID directly without existence validation; character/object PartOf takes priority over At, otherwise character holders recurse. Depth>16 gives None. ancestors follows Parent and stops before a repeated parent or after 65 entries. near accepts unknown places and accepts known equality or ancestor containment, not arbitrary siblings.
